## Description | 描述

Brief description of the changes.
简要描述本次更改。

## Related Issue | 关联 Issue

Fixes #(issue number)

## Type of Change | 更改类型

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that causes existing functionality to change)
- [ ] 📖 Documentation update
- [ ] 🔧 Refactor / code cleanup
- [ ] 🎨 UI / UX refinement

## Checklist | 检查清单

- [ ] My code compiles without errors (`cargo check` & `cd frontend && npm run build`)
- [ ] I have tested my changes locally
- [ ] I have updated documentation if necessary
- [ ] My changes follow the project's architecture and coding style

## Screenshots / Demos | 截图或演示

If applicable, add screenshots or recordings to demonstrate your changes.
如果适用，添加截图或屏幕录制展示你的更改。
